note: Source of truth for the app directory on /best-adhd-app/. Only posts ABOUT APPS belong here (no printables, guides or coaches). One category per card. Rebuild: node rebuild-app-directory.js --live Icons: "apps" maps a key to its name + official App Store icon (uploaded to WP media). A card shows card.apps, or the apps named in its title.
autoCategory: see AUTO_RULES in rebuild-app-directory.js: slug words vs/versus/comparison -> compare, alternative(s) -> alternatives, ends in review -> reviews; then the same on the title
